capabilities: Copy a whole note to the clipboard as Markdown
Include the filename and/or YAML frontmatter via presets
Copy unopened notes from the file explorer context menu
Enable or disable each preset in settings
extras: MIT-licensed open source; README states no network access, no telemetry, no account, and read-only access to the vault; includes a full Japanese translation of the documentation; developer solicits support via Buy me a coffee.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to copy an entire note to the clipboard as Markdown without selecting all text manually.
summary: Clipboard exporter that copies the whole current note as Markdown, optionally with the filename and YAML frontmatter, via commands or context menus.
